Function Details

copyData(railyard, refMap=False)

 

Return a copy of the data structures in the railyard, keeping relative references intact.

The function returns a MutableRailyard instance containing the copied data in unlocked form. If refMap is true, an extra element, mapping old to new references, is returned as the second return value.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) - The railyard to copy data from.
  • refMap (bool) - If true, copyData also returns a dictionary, mapping old references to new references, as an extra second return value.
Returns: MutableRailyard | (MutableRailyard, {IRailyardEntity:IRailyardEntity})
Copy of railyard "in unlocked pieces". The c{MutableRailyard} returned is a struct like class containing: the graph, the registered paths, the registered areas, and the auxiliary objects. Optionally, as a second return value, the map from old references to new references is included.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

restrict(railyard, areaRestriction, refMap=False, skipObjectTypes=None, intersectAreas=False)

 

Return a copy of the data structures in the railyard restricted to areaRestriction, keeping relative references intact.

The function returns a c{MutableRailyard} instance containing the copied data in unlocked form. If refMap is true, an extra element, mapping old to new references, is returned as the second return value.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) - The railyard to copy data from.
  • areaRestriction (IGraph) - The area the copy is restricted to.
  • refMap (bool) - If true, copyData also returns a dictionary, mapping old references to new references, as an extra second return value.
  • skipObjectTypes (Iterable(str) | none) - The Signal user types that should be legal on the boundary (and hence not copied).
  • intersectAreas (bool) - If false (the default), the restriction will include only areas that are contained in the areaRestriction. Otherwise, the restriction will also include the intersecting part of areas that are only partially in areaRestriction.
Returns: MutableRailyard | (MutableRailyard, {IRailyardEntity:IRailyardEntity})
Copy of railyard "in unlocked pieces". The MutableRailyard returned is a struct like class containing: the graph, the registered paths, the registered areas, and the auxiliary objects. Optionally, as a second return value, the map from old references to new references is included.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

filterCopy(railyard, relations, skipUserTypes, deleteEmptyNodes)

 

Filter a copy of the data structures in the railyard.

The function returns a 2-tuple. The first element of the tuple is a MutableRailyard instance in unlocked form where all objects whose types in skipUserTypes are filtered out. If deleteEmptyNodes is true, the empty nodes of degree 2 are also filtered out.

If deleteEmptyNodes is true, the second element of the returned tuple is a copy of relations with the true points of each Relation instance in relations being modified due to the removal of empty nodes. Otherwise, the element is relations itself.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) - The railyard to copy from.
  • relations ([Relation]) - relations on the railyard components.
  • skipUserTypes (Iterable(str)) - objects of user type in skipUserTypes are filtered out in the the returned MutableRailyard instance.
  • deleteEmptyNodes (bool) - If true, empty nodes of degree 2 are filtered our in the returned MutableRailyard instance.
Returns: tuple(MutableRailyard, [Relation])
A tuple of a filtered copy of railyard "in unlocked pieces" and the relations on the railyard components in the filtered railyard.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

elimCrossings(railyard, crossingNodes, areaNamer, splitAreaTypes, locked=True)

 

Eliminate crossing nodes in crossingNodes in the railyard.

The function returns an IRailyard instance from railyard where the crossing nodes in crossingNodes are eliminated. The elimination of crossing nodes might cause areas of a user type in splitAreaTypes disconnected and areaNamer is a function to name these areas.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) - The railyard to manipulate.
  • crossingNodes (Iterable(INode)) - The crossing nodes to be eliminated.
  • areaNamer (any) - A callable having signature (IGraph) -> str. areaNamer should return the desired names for the split areas of user type in splitAreaTypes.
  • splitAreaTypes (Iterable(str)) - areas of user type in splitAreaTypes are checked for connectivity after the elimination of cross nodes in crossingNodes.
  • locked (bool) - If true, all IRailyardObject instance and INode instances in the returned railyard are locked.
Returns: IRailyard
A copy of the railyard where the crossing nodes in crossingNodes are eliminated.
